negative_scope_guard: Failure of Heron^m membership in J332 is only failure of this 560-generator subideal and does not imply T^m is outside I_mix.
normalization_contract: Unscaled P_sigma is the exact signed 256-word mixed-H contraction. The stored generator is G_sigma=16 P_sigma; 16 is a unit over Q. In R/I_mix, Heron=8T. Therefore an exact identity Heron^m in <G_sigma> implies 8^m T^m in I_mix and hence T^m in I_mix over characteristic zero.
orientation_action: A site permutation sends an unordered edge block to its image; if image endpoint order reverses, a,b,c are unchanged and h acquires sign -1. Thus S8 acts by signed variable permutations.
positive_scope_guard: A positive identity must replay over Q with all generator outputs and the scale16/scale8 factors above; a modular result alone is not a proof.
target: Heron^2, homogeneous degree24; source multipliers degree20
